subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action-pin update land after a rebased exact-head validation of the credentialed and release-sensitive workflows, or should the sensitive action families be split for separate rollout?
rationale: CI cannot fully exercise scheduled, secret-bearing, publication, and release-only paths, while the protected security signal requires an owner to accept the remaining operational risk.

options.title: Rebase and validate together
options.body: Rebase the PR and merge the grouped update only after representative Codex, CodeQL, token-generation, Docker, and workflow-sanity lanes succeed on the exact head.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker/release action updates if failures persist or maintainers want independently reversible rollouts.

recommendation.title: Rebase and validate together
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and merge the grouped update only after representative Codex, CodeQL, token-generation, Docker, and workflow-sanity lanes succeed on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Release workflow operation and publication history make steipete the best available owner for accepting or narrowing this cross-workflow rollout.
